scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n mock,backend,frontend -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev:mock" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.production: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
